## Kept type

What `keep` decides on: found (maybe cut) or absent. Not the value: retention never depends on  it, and leaving it out keeps the loader's value type inferred from `load` alone.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Kept = {
    readonly found: true;
    readonly absent: false;
    readonly cut?: Cut;
} | {
    readonly found: false;
    readonly absent: true;
};
```
**References:** [Cut](./hopgraph.cut.md)
